proposals.title: Camera drops onto a setting toggle + tapped button, a ray fan opens, rows of reels stack up as the camera pulls back
proposals.why: The whole DJ2 comp as a reusable 'one tap → reaches lots of people' beat: CAM CTRL drop-in, rigged toggle row and button, expression ray fan, repeater reel wall revealed row by row on the zoom-out steps. Labels, colours, counts and beats are knobs.
proposals.call: trialToggleReelWall(comp, {at, label: "Trial", on: true, button: "Post", buttonColor: "#566afa", rays: 7, rayColor: "#ededf2", cols: 7, rowsAt: [1.933, 2.733, 3.367], floodAt: 3.833, zoomTo: 43.37, exit: true})
proposals.overlaps: built from parts rayFan, settingRow, toggleSwitch, touchDot, cardGridStack, cameraDropIn, stepZoomOut, darkStage; no kit primitive covers it

proposals.title: Fan of thin curved light rays from one point, opening from a crossed lens to an open fan
proposals.why: Rays: 7 paths made by createPath expressions (k = −3…3, L = 1600) and three sliders: S2 bend 2201.1→1927.2, S3 end spread −617.5→1122.4 (0.5–1.0 s), Asym −0.1→−0.05; #ededf2 strokes 2.5 px; an inverted mask hides the tips.
proposals.call: rayFan(comp, {from: [x, y], count: 7, length: 1600, at: 0.5, duration: 0.5, bend: [2201.1, 1927.2], spread: [-617.5, 1122.4], asym: [-0.1, -0.05], color: "#ededf2", width: 2.5})

proposals.title: iOS-style switch driven by one 0–1 slider
proposals.why: Toggle: track 126×64 r32, white knob 50; UI CTRL Toggle slider drives track colour linear(#4c4c54 → #1385ff) and knob x linear(−31 → 32.5). Static on here; key the slider to animate it.
proposals.call: toggleSwitch(comp, {on: true, at, duration, x, y, onColor: "#1385ff", offColor: "#4c4c54"})
proposals.previewNote: The toggle never animates in this comp (UI CTRL Toggle is a static 1), so the preview is a still of the 'on' state.

proposals.title: Settings row: dashed-square icon, label and toggle
proposals.why: Trial Icon (dashed rounded square 68 r18, stroke 4.5, dash 19.5 / gap 10.6, rounded play triangle) + 'Trial' SF Pro Medium 52 + toggle at the right, all white on dark.
proposals.call: settingRow(comp, {label: "Trial", icon: "trial", on: true, x, y, width: 580})
proposals.previewNote: Static in this comp (the row only moves with the camera); a still of the row.

proposals.title: Gradient touch indicator that settles onto a button
proposals.why: Tap: 74 px circle, radial gradient #6270fb → #6a8dff (0.55) → #7ed8ff (0.88) → #8ce8ff; drifts (1228, 555) → (1207, 551) and scales 90 → 100 % over 0.5–1.5 s (out 20 %, in 90 %).
proposals.overlaps: proposals.json cursorClick (same job, showing a press) with a touch look instead of a cursor: could be its look: "touch" option

proposals.title: Wall of 9:16 cards that stacks up one row per beat, then floods the frame
proposals.why: Reel Grid: one card 293×474 r12 (#1a1a21, #d1d1d6 35 % stroke) × Columns repeater (7, step 313, centred) × Rows repeater (step −498, upward) whose copies jump on hold keys 0→1→2→3→24 at 1.933 / 2.733 / 3.367 / 3.833 s.
proposals.call: cardGridStack(comp, {cols: 7, card: [293, 474], gap: [20, 24], rowsAt: [1.933, 2.733, 3.367], floodAt: 3.833, floodRows: 24, direction: "up"})
proposals.overlaps: DJ5 reelCard is a single card with a play button (could be the cell); stagger gives rhythm but as entrances, these are instant cuts

proposals.title: Whole scene drops in from above on a camera null
proposals.why: CAM CTRL y −650 → 613.5 over 0–1.267 s, out [1500 px/s, 20 %], in [0, 80 %], then holds 0.37 s: a fast fall with a long soft landing.
proposals.overlaps: slideUp is the same curve idea on one layer (and upward); this moves a parent null downward

proposals.title: Camera pulls back in steps synced to content beats, then whips out
proposals.why: CAM CTRL scale 100 → 99.35 → 93.89 → 93.51 → 78.65 → 74.61 → 54.44 → 43.37 (1.667–4.467 s), each step right after a grid row appears, while position drifts down and exits at 2620 px/s (2960 at 5.067 s).
proposals.overlaps: proposals.json cameraDrift (slow push) and DJ3/DJ5 nullPullBack (one fast pull-back): this is a stepped, beat-synced pull-back
